image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rough, dark rocky substrate. The organism has an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates (valves). These plates are beige/tan with visible growth lines and texture. Surrounding the plates is a reddish-brown, leathery girdle (mantle) that appears slightly spiny or granular. The background consists of wet rock with some small encrusting organisms.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The anterior end (top of the image) shows no protruding sensory structures, eyes, or tentacles, consistent with the reduced head anatomy of a chiton.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Anterior end is blunt and indistinct.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front edge of the girdle is rounded and blunt, lacking any distinct head separation from the body mass.
Surface inspection reveals no antennae, eyestalks, or other sensory appendages.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Exactly eight distinct plate segments are visible, arranged in a linear sequence from anterior to posterior, with clear overlap between adjacent plates.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plates embedded in tough leathery girdle that may be smooth, spiny, or hairy.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates are clearly surrounded by a continuous peripheral band (girdle) which appears textured and leathery, colored reddish-brown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plate coloration ranges from grey, brown, green to mottled patterns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates exhibit a beige/tan coloration with mottled textures and visible growth lines, fitting the described range.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface features broad muscular foot for adhesion to rocky substrates.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a dorsal view; the ventral foot is completely occluded by the body and substrate contact.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body exhibits dorsoventrally flattened profile when clinging to surfaces.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The organism sits low against the rock surface, exhibiting a flattened profile typical of intertidal adhesion.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Can curl into defensive ball when dislodged.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a behavioral capability not observable in a static image of an attached specimen.
